rows.name: friendship
rows.reviewNotes: An intangible relationship, not a physical animal or object. Physical-trait questions are answered literally, not metaphorically; joy/love/usefulness are intentionally affirmative. Its figurative fragility is softened.

rows.name: mail (snail mail)
rows.reviewNotes: Postal letters and envelopes, not an actual snail or other organism. Variations in stationery size, colour and decoration use softened probabilities. Combustible refers to ordinary paper postal letters.
